description:
The long-simmering family feud with your sibling has reached a critical juncture, and the path to genuine peace now lies before you, involving **two players**: you and them. A complete, open reconciliation would heal the deep rifts and strengthen your bond profoundly, but this grand gesture only succeeds if both of you wholeheartedly commit; if you try alone while your sibling retreats, you'll be left utterly vulnerable and hurt, gaining nothing, while they secure their own quiet. Alternatively, if both of you opt for individual space, you'll achieve a tolerable but superficial calm, with the core issues left unresolved.

Option A: Reach out for a full, honest confrontation of all the underlying issues.
Option B: Keep your distance and prioritize your own emotional safety.

meta.rules_ref: Two players (potential partners, not adversaries) simultaneously choose to Hunt Stag (cooperative, high reward) or Hunt Hare (safe, individual). Hunting Stag requires both players to coordinate — it only succeeds if both commit. Payoffs: Mutual Stag = 4 points each (the best shared outcome). Mutual Hare = 3 points each. If one hunts Stag alone while the other hunts Hare, the Stag hunter gets 0 points (the attempt fails without a partner) and the Hare hunter still gets 3 points. The core tension is trust: both players benefit most from cooperating, but each risks everything if the other plays it safe. Action_A represents Hunting Stag. Action_B represents Hunting Hare.
